rationale: Inspect the actual shared NEWERP SQL Server schema read-only so all later repositories and mobile APIs bind to existing master/business tables instead of inventing duplicate structures.
validation_focus: Use the server-side .env connection only in memory; never print or persist the connection string or credentials.
Execute metadata/catalog reads only. No DDL, DML, migration, stored-procedure execution, or business-row export.
Identify actual customer, supplier, user, tenant/company, dictionary, inquiry-related tables plus keys, indexes and rowversion/concurrency columns.
Produce docs/NEWERP_SCHEMA_MAP.md and a value-safe machine-readable mapping under .ai/generated, with tests that reject secret/data-value leakage.
risks: Do not infer table names when metadata is unavailable; mark unknowns explicitly.
Do not alter shared SQL Server objects or NEWERP code.
Do not place any production/business row values in Git evidence.
